title: Building – Medium Hazard Industrial Occupancy – February 2025
description: An applicant designed a processing facility that handles and dispenses flammable liquids (low flash point) as a Group F, Division 2 medium-hazard industrial occupancy. The City classified the use as Group F, Division 1 high-hazard and refused the building permit.

refusal.basis: not applicable: building permit refusal under Permit Regulation s.26(c) (undertaking would contravene the Act). The tribunal expressly said it was not a refused-variance appeal.

outcome_summary: Permit refusal upheld because the F1 classification was reasonable. The tribunal also criticized the City's communication and its treatment of sealed professional reports.
